reviews.text: Great care from the doctors! Always kind and flexible to fit us in the agenda :)

Check-ups for old and older cats were very meager. A week after the visit, at the vet on Sunday (a consultation already costs €100 by then), they did see something at the back of the throat and considered his final days. For the other cat, who was on omeprazole, they said: stop. At home, I presented this to AI, and he said to taper off (just like with humans). Called the vet again and went there again... and made a schedule for five weeks of tapering off. With the other one, where a heart murmur was known, it wasn't even suggested to do an ultrasound so that medication (almost 12 years old) could perhaps be prescribed, but no... Five weeks later he was dead, most likely due to acute pulmonary edema caused by sudden heart decompensation. Blood sampling on three cats was very difficult for all three and was not done by the vet himself.
I have to call the crematorium myself to ask when the ashes were brought to the vet because they don't call when the ashes have been brought. Where do you set your priorities, huh. Back to my old vet, even if it means taking taxis because the distance is much greater.

Our experience with Dierenkliniek Dockland has been very positive. The vets and assistants are kind and knowledgeable. They also put both the cats and us at ease and explain everything well.

During our last appointment, our cat Yuki was not cooperating with everything, and the vet's approach was very sensitive and solution-oriented.

All in all, my husband and I are happy with this lovely place in our neighborhood.

Very slow service was in the vets for over an hour just for a worming tablet so we could travel back to the UK! They tried to charge me for a 2nd Pet certificate that we didnt need we just needed them to sign her current certificate! I had to call my vets back at home in the uk to tell them how to do their job! The certificate they tried to charge me for would have been declined at the Le shuttle very poor service

My elderly dog ​​received excellent care. Good advice delivered with a certain down-to-earth attitude. The euthanasia was also handled very well. All praise. Good luck with expanding the practice. Highly recommended.
Our Cleo was really in good hands. She is eating again and active again!! Dear doctors and assistants

About a year ago, I had an issue with my dog. While he was running outside during a walk, he suddenly started limping. I visited this particular clinic, and the treatment ended up being quite expensive. As far as I remember, they told me that they would call us to check how the dog was doing.

They never called us.

And now, more recently, we went to have my dog’s annual vaccination. A wound was found, so the vet decided that it would be better to give him painkillers and antibiotics first and then proceed with the vaccination.

€112.50 for a three-day treatment and medication. 💊

I honestly feel that the only thing they care about is taking people’s money.

My two male cats, Max and Moritz, received excellent care at this practice for three years, starting from seven weeks old. The prices are very reasonable, and the staff are very friendly and knowledgeable. I have since moved to The Hague and hope to find an equally good practice.
